args.lesson: Verdict DO_NOT_PURSUE for a generic CSV checker on Apify. A targeted Store query ('csv validator') found 12 direct validator/preflight competitors, each with at most 2 total users and 1 user in 30 days (about 25-38 runs, which looks like developer test runs). The broad 'csv' query had hidden this because scrapers and transformers dominate it. The follow-up snapshot had stats identical to the original (same lastRunStartedAt), so a same-week re-fetch gives no trend data. Next time, run the narrow competitor-job query first (search=<job> <verb>) and count incumbents with real users before building. If the incumbents have ~0 users, stop. Paid-user share is never visible in the public API.
